subject.title: fix(auth): harden JWT and Teams failure semantics

question: Does this patch preserve the intended JWT trust boundary and Microsoft Bot Framework failure contract across invalid-token, key-service outage, timeout, and invoke-activity paths?
rationale: The changes affect credential verification, remote signing-key trust, provider availability, and externally observable protocol behavior; CI alone cannot establish the intended security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve after protocol review
options.body: Confirm the complete exact-base implementation against authoritative Bot Framework behavior and the added concurrency tests before marking the draft ready.

options.title: Require runtime evidence
options.body: Keep the draft open until a redacted controlled HTTP transcript demonstrates the distinct invalid-token, signing-service failure, timeout-recovery, and invoke-response paths.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Split shared JWT-cache hardening from Teams response-semantic changes if reviewers cannot confidently validate both boundaries together.

recommendation.title: Approve after protocol review
recommendation.body: Confirm the complete exact-base implementation against authoritative Bot Framework behavior and the added concurrency tests before marking the draft ready.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the only evidence-backed repository member connected to both affected paths in the supplied context.
